title: A growing list
hints: In `list_push`, when `length == capacity`, work out the new capacity (4 if it was 0, otherwise double), call `realloc` into a **temporary** pointer, and only replace `items` if it is not `NULL`.
Then `list->items[list->length++] = value;`. `list_free` frees `items` and resets everything to the empty state.
rules: Assign realloc's result to a temporary first.

rules.message: Assign realloc's result to a temporary first.
